blockers.title: Eight open task pull requests conflict with the line
blockers.rec: each builder merges the line tip into its branch before asking for review (PRs 458, 448, 443, 429, 425, 376, 337, 317).
blockers.why: ADR-0076: the builder merges the integration line into the task branch so conflicts surface in the task; the eleven mergeable PRs can land meanwhile.
blockers.alt: land the eleven mergeable PRs first and rebase the eight afterwards, which moves the same conflicts later and adds more.

blockers.title: The EPC-024 line cannot be fast-forwarded to the 4.0.0 tip
blockers.rec: retire the EPC-024 line and re-cut it from the 4.0.0 tip in one planning PR; its tip e283948c6 is contained in the 4.0.0 line with no unique commits and no open PRs into it.
blockers.why: the plain fast-forward push was refused by the pre-push codeflow ci, which judged the 167 commits as a PR range (acceptance-binding blocks, stale hook binary); nothing moved and nothing was lost (board, 2026-10-31 about 20:28).
blockers.alt: file the gap as a task and wait for the pre-push fix and the hook binary refresh; EPC-024's 21 tasks cannot start until then.

blockers.title: The installed codeflow 3.1.0 rejects the line's test configuration
blockers.rec: install the line's own build as the hook binary (or set CODEFLOW_HOOK_BINARY per lane) until 4.0.0 publishes.
blockers.why: `targets[1].heavy` is unknown to 3.1.0, so every lane pushing to the line hits the refusal; the planning lane already had to use its worktree build.
blockers.alt: keep 3.1.0 and set the hook binary lane by lane, which repeats the workaround in every brief.

blockers.title: git fetch in the codeflow checkout reports an error on a broken local ref
blockers.rec: repair the TSK-412 worktree ref (`git worktree prune`, then remove the broken `refs/heads/task/TSK-412-...` entry) from your own terminal.
blockers.why: fetch completes and the origin refs did update (the line tip was read live at 2026-11-01 14:31 EST), but each fetch prints "bad object refs/heads/task/TSK-412-..." and "did not send all necessary objects"; agents must not delete refs.
blockers.alt: leave it; every fetch keeps printing the error and a future fetch may stop updating refs.
